summary: [para 6] 6. The capital cost and AFC as approved for the 2014-19 tariff period in Petition No. 11/RP/2023 were as under: [para 8] 8. In terms of Regulation 13 of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition for truing up of the tariff of the generating station, based on the actual additional capital expenditure incurred for the period 2019-24. The capital cost and the annual fixed charges claimed by the Petitioner are as under: [para 13] 13. Accordingly, in terms of Regulation 19(1) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, the capital cost of Rs. 101517.90 lakh, has been considered as the opening capital cost as on 1.4.2019, for the purpose of truing up the tariff for the period 2019-24. [para 20] 20. We have considered the matter. Based on the submissions of the parties and on a prudence check, the additional capital expenditure is dealt with in the subsequent paragraphs. [para 26] 26. Accordingly, the total additional capital expenditure allowed for the period 2019-24 is as under: [para 172] 172. In terms of Regulation 91 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, any interest amount associated with the arbitration award and actually paid shall be recovered in instalments along with carrying cost at the rate specified under Regulation 10(6) and 10(7) of these Regulations. Further, with regard to the Petitioner’s claim for notional interest of Rs. 1546 lakh, it is observed that there is no provision under the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the grant of notional interest. The same shall be examined, if required, upon actual payment pursuant to the final adjudication of the matter by the Hon’ble High Court. [para 173] 173. Accordingly, in line with para 156 and 169 of the instant order, the total amount of Rs. 2749.02 lakh (Rs. 759.95 lakh + Rs. 1989.06 lakh) is allowed in terms of Regulation 91 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, and the Petitioner is allowed recovery of the amount in 6 equal instalments as reimbursement from the beneficiaries. [¶] imposed by the State and Central Government. Accordingly, in terms of Regulation 77 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the Petitioner is entitled to the reimbursement of statutory charges by considering normative parameters specified in the 2024 Tariff Regulations directly from the beneficiaries.
title: Petition for truing-up of 2019-24 tariff and for determination of 2024-29 tariff for the Salal Power Station (690 MW). NHPC Limited
